info.name: SolaCliq API (local)
info.description:
Generated from `api/openapi.yaml` by `api/postman/generate.py` (`make postman`); don't edit by hand. Every person, company and value here is illustrative.

Against the seeded local API: `cargo run -- seed`, then run the folders in order. See `api/postman/README.md`.

item.name: 1. Start here: log in as each role

request.description:
**Service health** (`getHealth`) · as no login

Whether the API and its database are up. Needs no authentication.
503 with the same body when the database can't be reached.

**Log in** (`login`) · as no login

`client: app` returns a token pair in the body. `client: web` sets
the access and refresh cookies and returns no tokens. An unknown
email, a wrong password and an account with no password yet all
give the same `auth.invalid_credentials`, so log in can't show
which emails have accounts or were invited. Someone invited sets
a password through /auth/password/forgot and /reset, or signs up.

item.name: 3. Installer (Ravi)

request.description:
**The home screen for the caller's role in this company** (`getOrgHome`) · as Ravi, installer

The server composes it for the role, from the same parts: a worker's
week and tasks, an agent's customers and KYC, a customer's install
progress, or their live energy after handover. Images are URLs;
sample data uses `asset:<name>` for pictures bundled in the app.

**The caller's tasks in this company** (`listMyTasks`) · as Ravi, installer

Workers only. `today`: open work due today or overdue, plus any
returned or with a problem whatever its date, and what's with the
admin, in due order (Indian time). `upcoming`: due later, by day.
`done`: approved and cancelled, newest first.

**The caller's tasks in this company** (`listMyTasks`) · as Ravi, installer

Workers only. `today`: open work due today or overdue, plus any
returned or with a problem whatever its date, and what's with the
admin, in due order (Indian time). `upcoming`: due later, by day.
`done`: approved and cancelled, newest first.

**The caller's tasks in this company** (`listMyTasks`) · as Ravi, installer

Workers only. `today`: open work due today or overdue, plus any
returned or with a problem whatever its date, and what's with the
admin, in due order (Indian time). `upcoming`: due later, by day.
`done`: approved and cancelled, newest first.

**One task with its customer, photos, checklist and status** (`getTask`) · as Ravi, installer

Photo and receipt links in it expire after 15 minutes.

**Tick or untick one checklist item** (`setTaskChecklistItem`) · as Ravi, installer

Fails with 409 `task.locked` once submitted.

item.name: Get an upload URL (what the scripts below do first)

request.description:
Returns a signed R2 URL for 15 minutes. The requests that need a file do this, then PUT a small file to that URL, in their pre-request script.

**Get a presigned URL to upload one file for this company** (`createUpload`) · as Ravi, installer

The app PUTs the file to `url` with `headers`, then sends
`upload_id` with the record it belongs to, in the same company.
Every file belongs to one company: an upload made here can only
be attached to this company's records, and is stored under the
company's own prefix. URLs expire after 15 minutes. Sample data
uses a `.invalid` host, which the development app treats as
uploaded. Each kind is for the roles that use it: `proof` for
workers, `receipt` for workers and agents, `kyc` for agents; the
org admin may upload any, and only the org admin uploads `logo`.
Otherwise 403 `org.role_not_allowed`. A `logo` is PNG or JPEG, up
to 1 MB (422 on `content_type` or `size_bytes` otherwise). A
`kyc` file is up to 50 MB, `receipt` and `proof` up to 10 MB
(422 on `size_bytes` over it).

**Attach a proof photo to one of the task's photo slots** (`addTaskPhoto`) · as Ravi, installer

The photo comes from the live camera only, never the gallery, and
carries where and when it was taken, and whether the phone said
the location was mocked. All of it is stored as sent: the server
doesn't compare it with the site or judge it.
Replaces an earlier photo in the slot (a retake). 422 on
`upload_id` when the file isn't in storage whole (the upload
didn't finish). 409 `task.locked` once submitted.

exec: function uploadFiles(token, purpose, contentType, n, done) {
const body = 'SolaCliq Postman test file (illustrative) ' + Date.now() + ' ' + ids.length;
body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ content_type: contentType, size_bytes: body.length, purpose }) },
if (err || res.code !== 201) { console.error('upload ticket failed', err || res.text()); return; }
if (err2 || res2.code >= 300) { console.error('file PUT failed', err2 || res2.code); return; }

**The home screen for the caller's role in this company** (`getOrgHome`) · as Meena, sales agent (commission)

The server composes it for the role, from the same parts: a worker's
week and tasks, an agent's customers and KYC, a customer's install
progress, or their live energy after handover. Images are URLs;
sample data uses `asset:<name>` for pictures bundled in the app.

**An agent registers a customer with their KYC** (`submitCustomerRegistration`) · as Meena, sales agent (commission)

Agents only. Submits details, site, connection and KYC documents for
the org admin to approve. On submission the customer's account is
created, with no password (or an existing one linked), and they
are emailed at once: who registered them, what was registered,
and how to set up the app to follow their install. The admin then
verifies or rejects it; the customer sees the status in the app. Required documents: Aadhaar,
PAN, electricity bill, land document and signature
(`registration.document_required`, 422, naming the kind); bank
proof too when the subsidy is on (`registration.bank_proof_required`,
422). Roof photo and name change are optional. Each kind once;
each file an upload of this company (purpose `kyc`), checked in
storage. 409 `registration.duplicate` when the company already has
this customer (same email, phone or consumer number), or the
person is already in the company in another role; the detail says
who registered them and when.

item.description: Seeded admin Dev. Acts on what folders 2–5 made.

request.description:
**The caller's notifications in this company, newest first** (`listNotifications`) · as Ravi, installer

The `unread_count` drives the dot on the bell.

**Mark all of the caller's notifications here as read** (`markNotificationsRead`) · as Ravi, installer

The "Read all" link on the notifications screen.

**The caller's own notifications, outside any company** (`listMyNotifications`) · as Ravi, installer

Quote requests and guides, for the Personal workspace.

**Mark all of the caller's own notifications as read** (`markMyNotificationsRead`) · as Ravi, installer

The "Read all" link in the Personal workspace.

A made-up token: the push worker's send to it fails and is logged. Use a phone's real token to test pushes.

**Save this phone's push token** (`registerMyDevice`) · as Ravi, installer

The Firebase Cloud Messaging token for the caller's session (one
login on one phone). Send it after log in, on each app start
while logged in, and whenever Firebase issues a new one. It
replaces this session's earlier token, and is taken from any
other session that had it, so pushes go to whoever logged in on
the phone last. Log out (or any revoked session) stops pushes to
it; there is no separate call. App sessions only: the website
gets 403 (`auth.app_only`). Pushes carry the notification's
`title` and `body`, with `data` holding `notification_id`,
`kind`, and whichever of `org_id`, `task_id`, `expense_id` and
`customer_id` it has (see docs/features/F12-notifications.md).

**The caller's personal details and payout bank** (`getMyDetails`) · as Ravi, installer

Shared by every company the person works with: their admins see
them for salary, commission payouts and site passes. The bank
account number comes back masked (`account_last4`).

**Change the caller's personal details or payout bank** (`updateMyDetails`) · as Ravi, installer

Send only what changes. A new bank needs `account_number` and
`ifsc`; the server fills `bank_name` from the IFSC.

**The caller's notification settings** (`getMySettings`) · as Ravi, installer

The same on every phone the person signs in on.

**Change the caller's settings** (`updateMySettings`) · as Ravi, installer

Send the whole object.

**Ask for a solar quote** (`createQuoteRequest`) · as Ravi, installer

Saves a lead and emails it to MarkCliq (`REVIEW_EMAIL`), who calls
the person on their phone (the account's, or `phone` here if the
account has none; 422 `quote.phone_required` if neither). The
person gets a `quote_shared` notification. Returns a general,
indicative estimate from the bill band. At most 5 a day per account
(429 `auth.too_many_attempts`); a retry with the same key isn't counted. Companies accepting leads
comes with the admin website.

item.name: 9. Team (admin)

request.description:
**The org's admin, workers and agents** (`listMembers`) · as Dev, the company's admin

Org admin only. Used by the admin website's team page.

**Add a worker or agent** (`addMember`) · as Dev, the company's admin

Org admin only. If the email has no account, one is created with no
password and a set-up email is sent (the person then uses "Set up
your account", F1). If it has an account, only a membership is
added and the person is emailed that they were added. One role per
person per org: `member.already_in_org` (409) otherwise. The role
must be `worker` or `agent`: `member.role_not_allowed` (422). Agents
need a `pay_type` (`member.pay_type_required`, 422) and other roles
can't have one (`member.pay_type_not_allowed`, 422). Someone removed earlier can be added again: their
membership comes back with the new role and pay type.

**Remove a worker or agent from the org** (`removeMember`) · as Dev, the company's admin

Org admin only. Ends the membership, not the account: it is marked
removed (kept, not deleted), drops out of the member list and the
person's `/me`, and their requests to this org get 403
`org.not_member` at once. The org admin can't be
removed (`member.cannot_remove_admin`, 422). Their past records
(jobs, expenses, customers) stay with the org.

item.description: Adding a member emails them: run against a server whose mail goes to the log (README.md).

item.name: 10. Company registration and MarkCliq review

request.description:
**A solar company registers with SolaCliq** (`registerOrg`) · as no login

Public. The server checks the details first: GSTIN format and
checksum (`org.gstin_invalid`, 422), a GSTIN already registered and
not rejected (`org.gstin_taken`, 409), and the usual field rules
(`validation.failed`). PAN and state are taken from the GSTIN.

Then, in one transaction, it saves the company as `pending`, the
owner's account (no password; an existing account with this email
is used as it is) and their `org_admin` membership. MarkCliq is
emailed to review it, and the owner is emailed that it arrived.
A platform admin then approves or rejects it
(`/platform/orgs/{org_id}/status`).

  "legal_name": "Postman Solar {{run}} Private Limited (illustrative)",
  "trade_name": "Postman Solar {{run}} (illustrative)",

request.description:
Needs Dev to be a platform admin: `cargo run -- make-platform-admin dev@example.com` once.

**Every company, newest first** (`listPlatformOrgs`) · as Dev, the company's admin

Platform admins only (`users.is_platform_admin`); anyone else gets
403 `platform.not_admin`. Filter with `status` (e.g. `pending` for
the review queue).

**One company's registration details** (`getPlatformOrg`) · as Dev, the company's admin

Platform admins only.

**Approve, reject, suspend or reactivate a company** (`setPlatformOrgStatus`) · as Dev, the company's admin

Platform admins only. Allowed moves: `pending` → `active`
(approve) or `rejected` (reject); `active` → `suspended`;
`suspended` → `active`. Anything else is 409
`org.status_change_not_allowed`. Rejecting needs a `note`, which is
emailed to the owner (`validation.failed` without one). Approving
emails the owner how to log in.

item.description: Registering emails MarkCliq's review inbox and the owner: run against a server whose mail goes to the log (README.md).

request.description:
**Get new tokens** (`refreshSession`) · as no login

OAuth 2.1 rotation, for the app and the website alike: returns a
new access token and a new refresh token, and the old refresh token
stops working. Reusing an old refresh token revokes that login. A
dead refresh token gets 401 `auth.session_expired`; the client logs
out. Clients run one refresh at a time.

The app sends `RefreshRequest` and gets a `TokenPair`. The website
sends no body (its `solacliq_refresh` cookie goes along) and gets
204 with new cookies.

The website's way: a session cookie instead of tokens. Postman keeps the cookie for localhost.

**Log in** (`login`) · as no login

`client: app` returns a token pair in the body. `client: web` sets
the access and refresh cookies and returns no tokens. An unknown
email, a wrong password and an account with no password yet all
give the same `auth.invalid_credentials`, so log in can't show
which emails have accounts or were invited. Someone invited sets
a password through /auth/password/forgot and /reset, or signs up.

**The signed-in person and their memberships** (`getMe`) · as no login

Used by both apps on start-up to restore the session.

**Log out of this session** (`logout`) · as no login

Revokes this session: its access and refresh tokens stop working at
once. Web clients also get both cookies cleared.

**Log out of this session** (`logout`) · as Ravi, installer

Revokes this session: its access and refresh tokens stop working at
once. Web clients also get both cookies cleared.

item.name: 12. By hand: sign up and passwords

request.description:
**Start signing up (email a code)** (`signup`) · as no login

Step 1 of 3, also how to ask for another code (one a minute).
Creates no account. Always 202, whether or not the email has an
account (no enumeration): one with a password gets a "you already
have an account" email instead of a code. An account made for
someone (invited, registered by an agent) gets a code and can
finish this way. 429 after 3 an hour for one email, whether or
not it has an account, or over the per-IP limit.

item.name: Sign up: enter the code (from the email)

request.description:
**Prove the inbox with the code** (`verifySignup`) · as no login

Step 2 of 3. Returns a one-time setup token for step 3. Codes last
5 minutes and allow 5 tries. A wrong, expired, used-up or never
sent code all answer 400 `auth.code_invalid`, so the reply can't
show which emails have accounts; 429 is only the per-IP limit.

**Create the account and log in** (`completeSignup`) · as no login

Step 3 of 3, with the setup token. Only now is the account made
(or, if someone made it for this person, completed): name, mobile,
password and the agreement to the terms are what was sent here,
nothing from before. Answers as an app login. The token works once
and for 15 minutes: after that, or if the account got a password
meanwhile, 400 `auth.signup_expired`.

**Email a password reset or set-up code** (`forgotPassword`) · as no login

Always 202 (no enumeration). Also used to set a first password on an
account created for someone. Codes last 5 minutes.

**Set a new password with the reset code** (`resetPassword`) · as no login

Ends every session of the account.

item.description: These send real emails and need the code from them: set `email` to an inbox you read, then `code`. Not part of the automatic run.

request.description:
**Delete the caller's account** (`deleteAccount`) · as Dev, the company's admin

Can't be undone. Erases the login and personal data and ends every
membership; a company's records of the person's work stay with it.
400 `account.password_incorrect`; 409 `account.last_admin` or
`account.platform_admin`.

**Change a worker's or agent's role or pay type** (`updateMember`) · as Dev, the company's admin

Org admin only (F21). `pay_type` (agents) applies from now on:
customers already registered keep their commission. `role` between
`worker` and `agent` only when nothing is open in the old role
(409 `member.has_open_work`, with what's open): an installer's
tasks assigned, in review or sent back; an agent's customers in
review or with them, commissions not yet paid, leads new or
contacted. Becoming an agent needs `pay_type`. The admin's own
membership can't change (422 `member.cannot_change_admin`). The
person's name, phone and email are theirs to edit, not here.

**Send a member's invite again** (`resendInvite`) · as Dev, the company's admin

Org admin only (F21). For a member who hasn't set a password yet:
the same email as when they were added. 409
`member.already_set_up` once they have one. At most 3 an hour per
address (429 `auth.too_many_attempts`).

**Set the company's logo (F15)** (`setOrgLogo`) · as Dev, the company's admin

The org admin only. `upload_id` is an upload of purpose `logo` by
the caller, in this company, not used yet, and present in storage
(422 on `upload_id` otherwise). Replaces the current logo; the old
file is deleted. Members see it through `/me`
(`memberships[].org.logo_url`).

**Remove the company's logo (F15)** (`removeOrgLogo`) · as Dev, the company's admin

The org admin only. The app shows the company's initials again.

**Start the caller's working day** (`startAttendanceDay`) · as Dev, the company's admin

Installers and salaried sales (`attendance.not_tracked`, 403, for a
commission agent). The day is the India date of the tap. Its time
is the server's clock less how long the tap waited on the phone
(`sent_at` minus `phone_at`, both by the phone's clock, so a wrong
phone clock moves nothing). A tap that waited over 5 minutes (sent
from offline) is marked `sent_late`; a negative wait counts as
none; over 7 days is refused (`attendance.too_old`, 422). A date
that already has a start gives `attendance.already_started` (409),
unless it is this request's own retry, which gets the first answer.

**End the caller's working day** (`endAttendanceDay`) · as Dev, the company's admin

Same callers and time rules as start. Ends the day of the tap's
India date; a day doesn't cross midnight. No start on that date,
or one after the tap: `attendance.not_started` (409). Already
ended: `attendance.already_ended` (409). An end can't be undone.

**Agree to the current Terms of Use and Privacy Policy** (`acceptTerms`) · as Dev, the company's admin

Records the agreement (who, which version, when, from which
address) as a new row; earlier ones are kept. For accounts someone
else made, and after the version goes up (F16).

**Don't accept an expense** (`rejectExpense`) · as Dev, the company's admin

Company admins only. From `in_review` or `needs_fix`, with a reason
the person sees. Final (409 `expense.locked` after).

**Say a claimed payment didn't arrive** (`paymentNotReceived`) · as Dev, the company's admin

Company admins only. A `claimed` payment goes back to `due`, and
the customer is told why and can pay or claim again. 409
`payment.not_due` otherwise.

**Everyone's attendance on one date** (`getAttendanceDay`) · as Dev, the company's admin

Company admins only (the website); read only. Every installer and
salaried sales member, by name, with their day on that date when
they have one; removed members only if they have a day on it.

**Everyone's attendance in one month** (`getAttendanceMonth`) · as Dev, the company's admin

Company admins only (the website); read only. The same people as
the day view (removed members if they have a day in the month),
each with their days, oldest first, and totals.

**One month's attendance as CSV** (`exportAttendanceMonth`) · as Dev, the company's admin

Company admins only. One row per person per day worked, by name
then date, UTF-8 with a header row. Times are India times
(`HH:MM`); `minutes` is empty without an end; `flags` lists
`start_sent_late`, `end_sent_late` and `no_check_out`, separated
by spaces. Sent as `attendance-YYYY-MM.csv`.

**The website's overview totals** (`adminGetOverview`) · as Dev, the company's admin

Company admins only. Read only; months and weeks are India's.

**The company's customers, newest first** (`adminListCustomers`) · as Dev, the company's admin

Company admins only. `q` looks in name, phone, email, reference and
consumer number, ignoring case.

**One customer, whole** (`adminGetCustomer`) · as Dev, the company's admin

Company admins only. The registration, every KYC document with a
15-minute link, the price, payments and commission.

**Move a customer's install stage** (`adminSetCustomerStage`) · as Dev, the company's admin

Company admins only. Either way, for a verified customer until
handover (409 `registration.locked`).

**Correct a customer's price** (`adminSetCustomerPrice`) · as Dev, the company's admin

Company admins only, until a payment is paid (409 `price.locked`).
The three parts are worked out again. A claimed payment goes back
to `due`, as the claim was for another amount, and the customer is
told the new amount of anything due.

**The company's tasks, newest first** (`adminListTasks`) · as Dev, the company's admin

Company admins only. `open`: assigned or returned. `problem`: open
with a reported problem. `done`: approved or cancelled.

**One task, with its proof and history** (`adminGetTask`) · as Dev, the company's admin

Company admins only. Photo links work for 15 minutes.

**Everyone's expenses, newest first** (`adminListExpenses`) · as Dev, the company's admin

Company admins only.

**One expense, with its receipt** (`adminGetExpense`) · as Dev, the company's admin

Company admins only. The receipt's link works for 15 minutes. Of
the payee's bank account, only the last 4 digits.

**Agents' commissions, newest first** (`adminListCommissions`) · as Dev, the company's admin

Company admins only. Not those of rejected customers. Of the
agent's bank account, only the last 4 digits.

**Customers' payments, newest first** (`adminListPayments`) · as Dev, the company's admin

Company admins only.

**The company's settings** (`adminGetSettings`) · as Dev, the company's admin

Company admins only.

**Change the company's settings** (`adminSetSettings`) · as Dev, the company's admin

Company admins only. An empty or null `upi_id` removes it, and
with it the "Pay by UPI" button of its customers.

**The company's 7 install stages** (`listStages`) · as Dev, the company's admin

Any member. In order, with each stage's template: what a new task
at that stage asks for. A stage the company hasn't changed has the
standard name and an empty template.

**Change one stage's name and template** (`adminSetStage`) · as Dev, the company's admin

Company admins only. Replaces the name, checklist and photos.
Blank items are dropped and repeats kept once. Tasks already made
keep what they were made with.

**Send a lead to a company** (`createLead`) · as Dev, the company's admin

For a landing page's server, with the company's lead key as the
bearer token (made in the website's Settings). Never call it from
a browser: the key would be public. 401 `lead.bad_key` for a
missing, wrong or replaced key. `consent` must be true (422
`lead.consent_required`). With an `external_id` already sent, the
first lead comes back with 200 and nothing changes. At most 300 an
hour per company (429 `auth.too_many_attempts`).

**The company's leads, newest first** (`listLeads`) · as Dev, the company's admin

Company admins only. `q` matches the name, phone, email or city.

**The leads handed to the caller, newest first** (`listMyLeads`) · as Dev, the company's admin

Sales agents only.

**One lead, with everything the form sent** (`getLead`) · as Dev, the company's admin

Company admins, or the agent it's with (404 for anyone else).

**Change a lead's status, note or agent** (`updateLead`) · as Dev, the company's admin

Company admins: any field. `agent_id` hands it to a Sales Agent of
the company (422 `lead.not_an_agent` otherwise), who is notified;
null takes it back. The agent it's with: `status` and `note` only
(403 `lead.admin_only` for `agent_id`). An empty note removes it.

**Delete a lead for good** (`deleteLead`) · as Dev, the company's admin

Company admins only. For a person asking to be forgotten.

**Whether the company has a lead key** (`adminGetLeadKey`) · as Dev, the company's admin

Company admins only. Never the key itself: it's shown once, when
made.

**Make a new lead key** (`adminMakeLeadKey`) · as Dev, the company's admin

Company admins only. Returns the key once. Any earlier key stops
working at once.
